card: Find a utility and run it in your browser.
title: ZTools for the small tool you need now
intro: ZTools keeps formatters, converters, encoders and generators in one browser toolbox. Pick the task and use its own page.

sections.heading: What is in ZTools?
sections.body: Formatters, converters, encoders and generators sit in one toolbox.

sections.heading: Where does a tool run?
sections.body: A tool runs in the browser, one page for the task you came to do.

sections.heading: What happens to your input?
sections.body: The product says input stays in the browser and is not uploaded.

sections.heading: Where does ZTools fit beside LifeWell?
sections.body: LifeWell keeps the record that matters to you. ZTools is for a single formatting, converting, encoding or generating task in the browser.
